sentences.text: Nasir Bin Olu Dara Jones -LRB- -LSB- nɑːˈsɪər -RSB- born September 14 , 1973 -RRB- , better known by his stage name Nas -LSB- ˈnɑːz -RSB- , is an American rapper , record producer , actor , and entrepreneur .	record producer	record producer	actor	actor	entrepreneur	entrepreneur	rapper	rapping	Olu Dara	Olu Dara

The son of jazz musician Olu Dara , Nas has released eight consecutive platinum and multi-platinum albums and has sold over 25,000,000 records worldwide .	jazz	jazz	Olu Dara	Olu Dara	platinum and multi-platinum	Music recording sales certification

He is also an entrepreneur through his own record label ; he serves as associate publisher of Mass Appeal magazine and is the owner of a Fila sneaker store .	entrepreneur	entrepreneur	Mass Appeal	Mass Appeal Records	associate publisher	Publishing	Fila	Fila (company)
He is currently signed to Mass Appeal Records .	Mass Appeal	Mass Appeal Records	Mass Appeal Records	Mass Appeal Records
His musical career began in 1991 , as a featured artist on Main Source 's `` Live at the Barbeque '' .	Main Source	Main Source

His debut album Illmatic -LRB- 1994 -RRB- received universal acclaim from both critics and the hip-hop community and is frequently ranked as the greatest hip hop album of all time .	Illmatic	Illmatic	greatest hip hop album of all time	List of hip hop albums considered to be influential

Nas 's follow-up It Was Written debuted at # 1 on the Billboard 200 , stayed on top for four consecutive weeks , went double platinum in two months , and made Nas internationally known .	It Was Written	It Was Written

From 2001-05 , Nas was involved in a highly publicised feud with fellow New York rapper Jay Z. Nas signed to Def Jam in 2006 .	New York	New York (state)	Def Jam	Def Jam Recordings	rapper	rapping	Jay Z	Jay Z

In 2010 , he released Distant Relatives , a collaboration album with reggae musician Damian Marley , donating all royalties to charities active in Africa .	Damian Marley	Damian Marley	Distant Relatives	Distant Relatives	Africa	Africa
